findings: PATCH.diff adds only crates/mori/tests/native_feature_boundary.rs (sha256 a07195e95d035b3fdfbd5dcf6c7767b041d6b06165530fee4179b7b0ddec879c) on prospectiveTree 7a89671b88b8e9e879c24657a299adcf6b7fac1e; all production files remain byte-identical to baseTree 23a78098cbdf690ac3b6f9a994f6d5033b869b18.

Crate-level #![cfg(not(feature = "native"))] gates the entire test binary so default/native builds compile zero tests from this target, while --no-default-features excludes optional mori-backend, mori-ledger, futures, rand, and midnight-* dependencies in crates/mori/Cargo.toml.

native_routes_report_unavailable_before_io tests all 13 pure-native subcommands and 4 native-gated mixed routes (inspect --target, simulate --trace --target, intent --profile+target+at, verify-intent --profile+target) across missing-inputs and populated-sentinels (34 invocations, exact 497-byte VALID-CORE2.mori sha256 b1f89331a3992e8f5135d9af6361a2347d0b45c0be74b0962c63ceb48de640c7), verifying exit 1, empty stdout, mori::command::native-unavailable, and unchanged TempRoot snapshots.

arg_and_clap_precedence_without_native_diagnostic verifies 6 clap validation/conflict cases (exit 2) and 4 mixed-command argument semantic checks in simulate::run, intent::signed, and verify_intent::run (exit 1) precede native_unavailable without emitting mori::command::native-unavailable (10 invocations; 27 catalog cases / 44 total CLI calls).

R2 uses explicit tuple destructuring `for &(label, argv, expected_msg) in semantic_cases` for clarity (STD-PATTERN-PROBE.json confirms the R1 binding also compiled with exit 0) and passes rustfmt --check with exit 0 (RUSTFMT-R2-CHECK.json).

PROPOSAL.json scopes one 90s+5s offline frozen -j1/--test-threads=1 cargo test invocation on target native_feature_boundary with --no-default-features, a 13-var env whitelist (no HOME or inherited auth), fresh owned empty cwd/CARGO_HOME/CARGO_TARGET_DIR/TMPDIR, 4 tool SHA-256 rechecks, and 14 ancestor Cargo config absence rechecks.
limitations: Test execution is UNRUN; approval covers candidate source and a single bounded execution attempt of PROPOSAL.json on exact tree 7a89671b88b8e9e879c24657a299adcf6b7fac1e, requiring fresh post-run result review before merge.

Directory tree snapshots (snapshot_tree) and error-precedence checks verify no filesystem mutations or output creation under TempRoot, but source audit and sentinel checks do not prove absence of read-only syscalls (no strace or kernel I/O seam).

No native, default-feature, workspace, clippy, workspace-wide rustfmt, proving, keygen, SRS, VM, financial execution, logical metering, or ledger acceptance paths are exercised or certified by this no-default-features CLI boundary test.
Compilation relies on the declared local TCB assumptions: pinned local toolchain/timeout binaries, system linker/libraries, and public Cargo registry/git caches symlinked into the owned CARGO_HOME.

Production code is unchanged from baseTree 23a78098cbdf690ac3b6f9a994f6d5033b869b18, all 27 catalog cases (44 CLI invocations) match actual #[cfg(not(feature = "native"))] command dispatch and argument precedence in crates/mori/src/commands/*, R2 tuple destructuring and rustfmt checks are clean, and resource isolation is properly bounded.
